# Physical Design with OpenROAD

## Concepts

Floorplanning, power distribution, placement, clock tree synthesis, and routing.

## Implementation

Analyze OpenROAD stages and their reports for a representative design.

## Hands-on Experiments

Explore floorplan and timing choices and track their effects on physical design results.

For each experiment, record the tool versions, design configuration, commands, inputs, expected results, and observed results.
